name: Kasugai Mio
source:
"My goodness, you're so spoiled, Nat-chan~  But that makes me happy~♪.

Height: Tall
Figure: Fair
Appearance: Fluffy
Favorite Things: Natsuki's frizzy hair, spicy food (Natsuki would die if she ate that)

Even if agitated by others, Mio, [url=https://vndb.org/c39150]Natsuki[/url]'s childhood friend, will always maintain her smile with a calm, gentle demeanor.  She goes at her own pace and is overprotective of Natsuki, though some might see this as a curse than a blessing.

Although she would like Natsuki to be a little bit more responsible, Mio can't stop herself from wanting to help her out.  After having the confidence of realizing each other's feelings, the two have been pretty much inseparable.

It kind of bothers Mio when she's seen as someone older due to her plain clothes, and she has some worry about her weight as well.

Featured in Drama CD Vol. 6 "Beside You".

[Translated from [url=http://www.particle.jp.net/lilycle_rs/chara06.html]Official Site[/url]]
